title: Morning Turmeric Ginger Drink
summary: A spicy anti-inflammatory drink built around turmeric, ginger, lemon, and black pepper.

ingredients.name: Turmeric
ingredients.rationale: Curcumin is studied for inflammatory pathways, though bioavailability is a known limitation.

ingredients.name: Black Pepper
ingredients.rationale: Piperine can increase curcumin bioavailability by slowing metabolism.

benefits.label: Anti-inflammatory
benefits.detail: Curcumin and gingerols are studied for inflammatory pathways.

science.mechanism: Curcuminoids influence inflammatory signaling, while piperine may increase curcumin exposure.
science.summary: Black pepper contains piperine, which may increase bioavailability of curcumin.
takeaways: Use a tiny pinch of pepper.
Pair with a little fat when possible.

prep.title: Boil water
prep.body: Bring water to a gentle simmer.

notes: I've noticed improved digestion when consuming this before breakfast.
